design.status_of_evidence: EXPLORATORY: HS-Stroke seed-42 pairs were examined in G3; nothing here is confirmatory
design.plan: the frozen G3 plan, rebuilt and checked against the historical commitment when supplied; seed-42 tasks only
arms_per_pair: E2/E4/E8 exact-optimum per-arm fit with k copies
F fixed base reference + exact LR
R reference of C+a' + exact LR on base rows only
design.audit: A1 every G3 public number recomputed from stored pair scores with independent aggregation code; A2 E1 vs stored (bitwise); A3 X1 vs stored primary arms (all pairs) and independent multiset, neighbour and placebo arms for one outcome-blind pair per task (rng [7201, seed, participant, fold])
design.estimands: all contrasts use the G3 pair formula and G3 aggregation (class-balanced within participant, 14 participants equal weight); t95 CI and exact sign-flip reported, labelled exploratory
design.reporting: every prediction P1-P4 is reported as met / not met, whatever the outcome

predictions_declared_before_any_fit.P1_reference_pathway_minor: fixed-reference d / exact d in [0.9, 1.1] and |reference-only d| < 0.1 points
predictions_declared_before_any_fit.P2_first_order_law: Newton-one-step d / exact d in [0.8, 1.25] (participant means) and pair-level Pearson r >= 0.9
predictions_declared_before_any_fit.P3_dose_sublinear: exact d(k) increases with k = 1, 2, 4, 8 and d(8) / d(1) < 8
predictions_declared_before_any_fit.P4_solver_tolerance_negligible: |exact-optimum d - G3 (lbfgs tol 1e-4) d| < 0.05 points (participant means)
